description: Williams Fernandes Fontinele and colleagues publish code and results for studying connection-order effects across distribution networks. The September 2026 version-two archive includes a sequential power-flow evaluator, memetic optimiser, network catalogue and five experiment campaigns, with analysis and figure scripts. The package is free under Apache-2.0; SimBench inputs retain ODbL and DbCL terms, and other network sources require their stated attribution. Coverage is user-selected benchmark networks, with no single geographic deployment. It can compare queue order, transformer constraints and accepted-generation capacity in planning simulations. The provider documents recovery of previously lost working files and regenerated analysis outputs, but those consistency claims were not independently reproduced. Related catalogue record model-pandapower is one solver dependency. The separate IEEE 33/69-bus queue study is related but has different data and licensing. Exact environment compatibility, uncertainty calculations and archive completeness remain unverified; no code was executed.
